answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A raven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jade of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the trellis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
